# Ifx

> Ifx is on-chain Solana orchestration: read state, branch, and CPI inside one transaction without deploying a new wrapper program each time. **ifx.run** is the official site — an offline wire explorer for Ifx instructions and SIMD-0385 v1 packets, plus synced design docs.

Ifx (program) and ifx.run (this site) are distinct: the explorer is read-only decode/display; it does not compose or send transactions.

## Site

- [Home](https://ifx.run/): Product overview
- [Explorer](https://ifx.run/explorer): Paste wire (hex / base58 / base64) or a signature; decode Ifx + known Solana programs offline (RPC only for signatures / ALTs)
- [Docs (EN)](https://ifx.run/docs): Design and implementation
- [Docs (ZH)](https://ifx.run/zh/docs): 中文文档
